issue_request: FHIR-31584 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R4B O&O change request asking for structured procedure/order parameters in ServiceRequest. The accepted resolution asked to make ServiceRequest.orderDetail a BackboneElement, add orderDetail.parameter with required code and value[x], add parameterFocus for the target device/request/medication/substance context, and carry corresponding parameter support into SupplyRequest.
initial_application: No current-branch source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-31584. The same change family was applied through FHIR-32265: f3d976857e converted ServiceRequest.orderDetail from CodeableConcept to a backbone with parameterFocus and parameter/code/value children, 6c47335c14 fixed value[x] choice serialization, a4b2e7aafc corrected orderDetail.parameter to 1..*, and a3d9d73c01 added the requested implementer feedback note. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-32265 audit commit.
additional_context: FHIR-32265 explicitly says it modified what was approved in FHIR-31584, and the 2023-02-16 O&O minutes record the later motion to add the implementer note about the modeling challenge when there is no focus versus repeating focus on each code/value pair. The current ServiceRequest source is active in fhir.ini and has the requested structure and note. SupplyRequest is no longer an active core resource: fhir.ini removed supplyrequest in 3b38b80cf2 and current core narrative links SupplyRequest to the OO incubator. The retained core SupplyRequest source file already has a parameter backbone with code/value, plus later FHIR-41665 binding work, but it is not a current core build target. Later R6 refinements such as FHIR-54847 are relevant context but are Resolved - change required and outside this applied/published seed decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current ServiceRequest source already satisfies the FHIR-31584/FHIR-32265 family outcome, and editing the out-of-build SupplyRequest source in core would not be an appropriate current-spec fix.
